confirmedIssues.title: camelCaseKeys duplicates opaque destination-map identities
confirmedIssues.proof: Source-proven production data-path mechanism; runtime NOTRUN.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Client recursively preserves each snake_case key and adds its camelCase alias, including dictionary keys such as signal_log/drive_telemetry/unit_history. Hook forwards transformed dictionaries; Object.entries treats original/alias as distinct destinations, duplicating bars/chips/category totals without adding real routes. Legitimate fan-out explanation does not justify aliases.
confirmedIssues.repro: Synthetic source trace: destination_totals:{signal_log:2} -> transformed destination_totals:{signal_log:2,signalLog:2} -> two bars/chips of2, though backend reports one destination. Repeat with category.destinations. No API call or executable helper was used.
confirmedIssues.coverageLimit: Page tests mock api/client request at FleetTelemetryCoveragePage.test.tsx:19-25 and supply pre-transform payloads, so the existing passing receipt is not evidence against this mechanism.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow assigned fix protecting opaque dictionary keys or normalizing this typed endpoint's destination dictionaries using established contract ownership; add a covering real-client-boundary regression in that future fix. Do not globally delete dual-shape behavior without auditing its other consumers.

confirmedIssues.title: Mobile category tables lose column and dual-write evidence
confirmedIssues.mechanism: mobileColumns allows only field/destination/subscribed. DataTable adds hidden md:table-cell to column/also_signal_log regardless of column-picker selection. mobilePresentation is opt-in and absent; no expandable renderer is supplied.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future synthetic375px review of a BrakePedal row with column brake_pedal and also_signal_log:true: its two metadata cells remain display:none below768px; scrolling/toggling columns does not remove allow-list CSS. Current source trace establishes the lost rendering path, not a measured screenshot.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow CoverageCategory mobile evidence fix using existing DataTable full-details/mobilePresentation contract or contained all-column scrolling; preserve stable tableId, filters, sort, exports and every field.

confirmedIssues.title: Paused first load is presented as an empty routing snapshot
confirmedIssues.mechanism: isLoading is isPending && isFetching. Offline-paused initial query is pending but not fetching, so firstLoad=false; fatalError=null; categories default[] reaches No categories returned, and chart reaches No destinations reported, even though no response exists.
confirmedIssues.repro: Symbolic query state data:undefined,isPending:true,fetchStatus:'paused',isError:false,isLoading:false,isFetching:false produces both false empty claims. Shared Paused offline notice and loading summary coexist but do not correct those section claims.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow page trust-state fix that distinguishes unresolved/refresh-blocked initial source from authoritatively returned empty data, preserving section shells, retained content and retries.

confirmedIssues.title: Subscription legend overstates generated policy as current ingestion
confirmedIssues.proof: Source-proven producer/consumer semantic disagreement; real ingestion NOTRUN.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Subscribed is membership in NewBuilder().SubscriptionFields, not confirmation a vehicle applied the policy or Tesla currently pushes the field. Legend says currently pushing, conflicting with package-only source/provenance.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source scenario: identical package/configuration with no connected vehicles or a disconnected stream still yields the same subscribed:true field policy, while the legend asserts active pushing. No real vehicle/stream scenario was executed.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow source-and-existing-catalog copy correction explaining configured desired subscription membership, not observed ingestion; no telemetry reconfiguration or invented runtime endpoint.

confirmedIssues.title: Five summary i18n labels are absent from canonical English
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Dynamic count tuples call t(key,fallback), but coverage.stat contains only subscriptionCoverage in canonical en.json. English fallback masks missing canonical localization.
confirmedIssues.repro: Executed read-only ConvertFrom-Json lookup of all64 distinct static/explicit dynamic keys prints these exact5 missing keys. Current canonical stat object at35962-35964 confirms absence.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow assigned adapter/catalog integration item: map to suitable existing canonical labels or integrate only these proven missing leaves through the normal catalog owner; no guard/baseline bypass.

confirmedIssues.title: Dash-column legend incorrectly identifies unit_history routes as signal_log
confirmedIssues.mechanism: All four Setting*Unit entries route to unit_history without per-field column. Handler returns that destination and omits empty column; UI renders dash. Legend says every dash means field stored in signal_log.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-derived SettingDistanceUnit response row has destination:'unit_history' and omitted column. Its rendered dash contradicts legend even in a healthy unchanged package. No response was fetched.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow existing legend/catalog correction describing absence of per-field column without assuming a destination; retain explicit destination and unit-history evidence.

confirmedIssues.title: Fetch timestamp bypasses saved locale/timezone/time display
confirmedIssues.proof: Source-proven preference bypass; native formatting NOTRUN.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: sourceFreshness accepts updatedAt/t only and calls Date.toLocaleString without locale/options; changing application locale/timezone or clock preferences cannot affect this timestamp formatter.
confirmedIssues.repro: Future synthetic fixed dataUpdatedAt with browser en-US/America-Los_Angeles and differing saved/app preferences remains browser-default output despite localized Fetched wrapper. No preferences were saved or browser invoked.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow existing sourceMetadata preference-aware display adoption through existing date/format hooks; evaluate its shared consumers and preserve last-success timestamp/unknown handling.

confirmedIssues.title: Filter has no persistent visible label
confirmedIssues.proof: Source-proven design-contract omission; accessible name is present.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Only placeholder and aria-label are passed. Shared Input renders visible Label only when label supplied; placeholder vanishes with entered text.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source state filter='BrakePedal' removes the placeholder from visual input presentation; no persistent visible filter label exists in its surrounding JSX. Screen readers still receive aria-label.
confirmedIssues.needs: One narrow page visible-label adoption using shared Input and canonical localized copy, preserving filter behavior/result live region.
